items.answer: Advisor (Si): moves exactly one step diagonally, confined to the palace (3x3 area). Cannot leave the palace. Elephant (Tuong): moves exactly two steps diagonally (like an '田' character). It can be blocked if there is a piece at the center of the diagonal path ('blocking the elephant eye'). The Elephant cannot cross the river - it stays on its own side of the board.

items.answer: The King is confined to the palace (3x3 grid: columns 3-5, rows 0-2 for Black, rows 7-9 for Red). It moves one step orthogonally within the palace. The 'flying general' rule (chieu doi tuong): two Kings cannot face each other on the same column with NO pieces between them. This means the King can effectively 'attack' the opposing King across the board like a Rook when the path is clear.

items.answer: The Cannon moves like a Rook (horizontally or vertically any number of squares) but CANNOT capture this way. To capture, the Cannon must jump over exactly ONE piece (called a 'screen' or 'mount') to hit the target. The screen can be any color. Moving without capturing: no jumping. Capturing: must jump exactly one piece. This dual mechanic makes the Cannon uniquely powerful.
